paths.name: @clerk/nextjs/server
paths.message: Derive the principal with getPrincipal/requirePrincipal/requirePagePrincipal from @/lib/auth. ADR 0001 makes that the only place identity enters the application, so a handler cannot invent its own notion of who is calling. Only lib/auth and proxy.ts may call Clerk directly.

no-restricted-syntax.message: Purchase is evidence of payment, not entitlement (ADR 0002). Decide access with courseEntitlement/topicEntitlement/entitledCourseIds from @/lib/entitlement. Reading Purchase for access is what let a suspended learner keep everything they had ever paid for. Payment history itself -- revenue reporting -- may read it; add an override here with a reason.

Do not query Enrollment directly to make an access decision (ADR 0002 point 1). Use @/lib/entitlement, which normalizes the status so an unrecognised value cannot read as access. Aggregate reporting over enrollments may read it; add an override here with a reason.
